{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"Gold leaf on water, and the crowd knows it. Go early, then let the garden do the talking."},{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Nightingale floors squeak on purpose. Walk slowly and hear the castle gossip."},{"poi_id":"p11","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Quiet halls, old clay, and a very good excuse to stand still for an hour."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Silver pavilion, sand garden, and the quietest corner of Kyoto if you arrive before the tour buses."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A canal-side stroll under bare winter branches; the path does the thinking for you."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Go early, before the selfie sticks wake up, and let the bamboo do the talking."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"The garden is the real sermon here; the pond listens better than most visitors."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m5","note":"Graze the stalls like a raccoon with excellent manners and a small purse."},{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The wooden stage leans out like it's gossiping with the whole city below."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A thousand golden Kannon statues, all watching you pretend you didn't just gasp."},{"poi_id":"p19","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Quiet vegan plates that even the hungriest temple-goer will forgive."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wooden facades, tea-house lanterns, and the occasional maiko moving faster than your camera."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Narrow riverside lane where the lanterns do the flirting for you."},{"poi_id":"p19","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Back for a gentle dinner, because halal-friendly and lovely is a rare double act."}]}
Shoes off, phone down, eyes up — every must-do tucked in, from Gion’s first taste to that quiet path.
